source: Fine-Tuning Vision-Language-Action Models: Optimizing Speed and Success
translation: 微调视觉-语言-动作模型：优化速度与成功率

source: Abstract—Recent vision-language-action models (VLAs) build upon pretrained vision-language models and leverage diverse robot datasets to demonstrate strong task execution, language following ability, and semantic generalization. Despite these successes, VLAs struggle with novel robot setups and require fine-tuning to achieve good performance, yet how to most effectively fine-tune them is unclear given many possible strategies. In this work, we study key VLA adaptation design choices such as different action decoding schemes, action representations, and learning objectives for fine-tuning, using OpenVLA as our representative base model. Our empirical analysis informs an Optimized Fine-Tuning (OFT) recipe that integrates parallel decoding, action chunking, a continuous action representation, and a simple L1 regression-based learning objective to altogether improve inference efficiency, policy performance, and flexibility in the model’s input-output specifications. We propose OpenVLA- OFT, an instantiation of this recipe, which sets a new state of the art on the LIBERO simulation benchmark, significantly boosting OpenVLA’s average success rate across four task suites from 76.5% to 97.1% while increasing action generation throughput by 26⟦0⟧. In real-world evaluations, our fine-tuning recipe enables OpenVLA to successfully execute dexterous, high-frequency control tasks on a bimanual ALOHA robot and outperform other VLAs (⟦1⟧ and RDT-1B) fine-tuned using their default recipes, as well as strong imitation learning policies trained from scratch (Diffusion Policy and ACT) by up to 15% (absolute) in average success rate. We release code for OFT and pretrained model checkpoints at ⟦2⟧.
translation: 摘要——近期视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）基于预训练的视觉语言模型，利用多样化的机器人数据集，展现出强大的任务执行能力、语言遵循能力和语义泛化能力。尽管取得了这些成功，VLA在新型机器人设置上仍面临困难，需要微调才能达到良好性能，然而在众多可能的策略下，如何最有效地微调它们尚不明确。本文以OpenVLA作为代表性基础模型，研究了VLA适配的关键设计选择，如不同的动作解码方案、动作表示和微调学习目标。我们的实证分析总结出一套优化微调（OFT）方案，该方案整合了并行解码、动作分块、连续动作表示和基于简单L1回归的学习目标，从而整体提升了推理效率、策略性能以及模型输入输出规范的灵活性。我们提出OpenVLA-OFT作为该方案的一个实例，在LIBERO仿真基准上达到了新的最新技术水平，将OpenVLA在四个任务套件上的平均成功率从76.5%显著提升至97.1%，同时将动作生成吞吐量提高了26⟦0⟧。在真实世界评估中，我们的微调方案使OpenVLA能够在双臂ALOHA机器人上成功执行灵巧的高频控制任务，并优于使用默认方案微调的其他VLA（⟦1⟧和RDT-1B），以及从头训练的强模仿学习策略（扩散策略和ACT），平均成功率最高提升15%（绝对值）。我们在⟦2⟧发布了OFT代码和预训练模型检查点。

source: I. INTRODUCTION
translation: 一、引言

source: Recent vision-language-action models (VLAs)—robot policies built by fine-tuning pretrained vision-language models on large-scale robot datasets for low-level robotic control—have demonstrated strong task performance, semantic generalization, and language following abilities across diverse robots and tasks ⟦0⟧. Despite their strengths, fine-tuning is crucial for satisfactory deployment of VLAs on novel robots and tasks, yet it is unclear what the most effective approach for adaptation is given the large design space. A robotics practitioner who wishes to fine-tune a VLA to a new robot setup and task may default to using the same training recipe used for pretraining (or a parameter-efficient variant), but it is not obvious whether this would yield the best policy, and there is limited empirical analysis of alternative fine-tuning approaches in the literature.
translation: 近期，视觉-语言-动作模型（Vision-Language-Action Models, VLAs）——通过在大规模机器人数据集上微调预训练视觉-语言模型而构建的、用于底层机器人控制的策略——已在多种机器人和任务中展现出强大的任务性能、语义泛化能力和语言遵循能力 ⟦0⟧。尽管具有这些优势，微调对于VLA在新机器人和新任务上的满意部署至关重要，然而在庞大的设计空间中，何种适应方法最为有效尚不明确。希望将VLA微调至新机器人设置和任务的机器人从业者，可能会默认采用与预训练相同的训练方案（或其参数高效变体），但这是否能产生最佳策略并不显然，且文献中对替代微调方法的实证分析有限。

source: Prior work has begun exploring VLA adaptation strategies, with Kim et al. ⟦3⟧ proposing parameter-efficient fine-tuning via LoRA. However, their autoregressive action generation remains too slow (3-5 Hz) for high-frequency control (25- 50+ Hz), and both LoRA and full fine-tuning of autoregressive VLAs often yield unsatisfactory performance in bimanual manipulation tasks ⟦4⟧. While recent approaches improve efficiency through better action tokenization schemes ⟦5⟧, achieving 2 to 13⟦0⟧ speedups, significant latency between action chunks (e.g., 750 ms for the recent FAST approach ⟦6⟧) still limits real-time deployment on high-frequency bimanual robots. Exploring alternative VLA adaptation approaches that achieve both satisfactory speed and quality remains an underexplored area of research. In this work, we study key design decisions for adapting VLAs to novel robots and tasks using OpenVLA, a representative autoregressive VLA, as our base model. We examine three key design choices: action decoding scheme (autoregressive vs. parallel generation), action representation (discrete vs. continuous), and learning objective (next-token prediction vs. L1 regression vs. diffusion). Our study reveals several key insights that build on each other: (1) parallel decoding with action chunking not only boosts inference efficiency but also improves success rates on downstream tasks while enabling greater flexibility in the model’s input-output specifications; (2) continuous action representations further improve model quality compared to discrete representations; and (3) fine-tuning the VLA with an L1 regression objective yields comparable performance to diffusion-based fine-tuning while offering faster training convergence and inference speed. Building on these insights, we introduce OpenVLA-OFT: an instantiation of an Optimized Fine-Tuning (OFT) recipe that integrates parallel decoding and action chunking, continuous action representations, and an L1 regression objective to enhance inference efficiency, task performance, and model inputoutput flexibility while maintaining algorithmic simplicity. We conduct experiments on both the standardized LIBERO simulation benchmark and dexterous tasks on a real bimanual ALOHA robot. In LIBERO, OpenVLA-OFT establishes a new state of the art by achieving 97.1% average success rate across four task suites, outperforming both fine-tuned OpenVLA policies ⟦7⟧ (76.5%) and⟦1⟧ policies ⟦8⟧ (94.2%) while achieving a 26⟦2⟧ speedup in action generation with 8-step action chunks. source: II. RELATED WORK
translation: II. 相关工作

source: Prior works have leveraged language and vision foundation models to enhance robotic capabilities, using them as pretrained visual representations that accelerate robotic policy learning ⟦0⟧, for object localization in robotics tasks ⟦1⟧, and for high-level planning and reasoning ⟦2⟧. More recently, researchers have explored fine-tuning vision-language models (VLMs) to directly predict low-level robotic control actions, producing “vision-languageaction” models (VLAs) ⟦3⟧, which have demonstrated effective language following ⟦4⟧ and generalization to out-of-distribution test conditions and unseen semantic concepts. These works focus primarily on model development, while we focus on developing a recipe for fine-tuning such models, justifying individual design decisions with insights that we gain from our empirical analysis.
translation: 先前的研究利用语言和视觉基础模型来增强机器人能力，将其用作预训练视觉表示以加速机器人策略学习⟦0⟧，用于机器人任务中的目标定位⟦1⟧，以及用于高层规划和推理⟦2⟧。近期，研究者探索了微调视觉语言模型（VLM）以直接预测底层机器人控制动作，从而产生“视觉-语言-动作”模型（VLA）⟦3⟧，这些模型已展现出有效的语言遵循能力⟦4⟧以及对分布外测试条件和未见语义概念的泛化能力。这些工作主要关注模型开发，而本文则专注于开发此类模型的微调方法，并通过实证分析获得的洞见来论证各个设计决策的合理性。

source: Despite the importance of fine-tuning for real-world VLA deployment, empirical analysis of effective fine-tuning recipes remains limited. While Kim et al. ⟦4⟧ study various parameter update strategies and from their findings show that LoRA fine-tuning enables effective adaptation to single-arm robots operating at low control frequencies (⟦0⟧ Hz), their analysis does not extend to bimanual robots with high control frequencies (25-50+ Hz), a more complex control scenario. We address this gap by exploring VLA adaptation design decisions for fast inference and reliable task execution on a real-world bimanual manipulator with a 25 Hz controller. Recent works by Belkhale and Sadigh ⟦5⟧ and Pertsch et al. ⟦6⟧ improve VLA efficiency through new action tokenization schemes, using vector quantization or discrete cosine transform-based compression to represent action chunks (sequences of actions) with fewer tokens than simple perdimension binning (as used in RT-2 ⟦7⟧ and OpenVLA ⟦8⟧). While these approaches achieve 2 to 13⟦1⟧ speedups for autoregressive VLAs, we explore design decisions beyond autoregressive modeling, which remains inherently limited by iterative generation. Our parallel decoding approach, when paired with action chunking, achieves significantly greater speedups: 26⟦2⟧ to 43⟦3⟧ throughput with much lower latency (0.07 ms for single-arm tasks with one input image and 0.321 ms for bimanual tasks with three input images). While these diffusion-based VLAs achieve higher action throughput than autoregressive VLAs by generating multitimestep action chunks simultaneously, they introduce computational trade-offs through slower training and multiple denoising or integration steps at inference time. Furthermore, these diffusion VLAs vary considerably in architecture, learning algorithm, vision-language fusion approach, and input-output specifications—and which design elements most significantly impact performance remains unclear. Through controlled experiments, we show that policies fine-tuned with a simpler L1 regression objective can match more complex approaches in task performance while achieving significantly greater inference efficiency. Lastly, unlike prior work that relies on a separate faster low-level control policy in addition to a slower VLA ⟦0⟧, in this work we fine-tune the base VLA end-to-end with techniques that enable high efficiency without needing a separate controller. Further, unlike other works that collect online interaction data to continually update specialist policies via reinforcement learning ⟦1⟧, here we focus on the simpler imitation learning paradigm in which we develop highperforming policies just by training once offline on a fixed dataset of expert task demonstrations.
translation: 然而，这些基于扩散的视觉语言动作模型（VLA）通过同时生成多时间步动作块，实现了比自回归VLA更高的动作吞吐量，但它们在推理时引入了计算权衡，表现为训练速度较慢以及多个去噪或积分步骤。此外，这些扩散VLA在架构、学习算法、视觉语言融合方法以及输入输出规范方面差异显著——哪些设计元素对性能影响最大仍不清楚。通过受控实验，我们表明，使用更简单的L1回归目标微调的策略在任务性能上可以与更复杂的方法相媲美，同时实现显著更高的推理效率。最后，与先前依赖独立更快的低级控制策略以及较慢的VLA ⟦0⟧ 的工作不同，在本工作中，我们端到端微调基础VLA，采用能够实现高效率的技术，而无需单独控制器。此外，与其他通过强化学习收集在线交互数据以持续更新专家策略的工作 ⟦1⟧ 不同，这里我们专注于更简单的模仿学习范式，在该范式中，我们仅通过在固定的专家任务演示数据集上离线训练一次来开发高性能策略。

source: Original OpenVLA formulation.
translation: 原始OpenVLA公式。

source: We use OpenVLA ⟦0⟧ as our representative base VLA, a 7B-parameter manipulation policy created by fine-tuning the Prismatic VLM ⟦1⟧ on 1M episodes from the Open X-Embodiment dataset ⟦2⟧. See Appendix A for architecture details. OpenVLA’s original training formulation uses autoregressive prediction of 7 discrete robot action tokens per timestep: 3 for position control, 3 for orientation control, and 1 for gripper control. It employs next-token prediction with cross-entropy loss as its learning objective, similar to language models. We explore alternative formulations including parallel decoding, continuous action representations, and learning objectives like L1 regression and diffusion modeling in the next few sections.

translation: 四、研究关键视觉语言动作微调设计

source: DECISIONS In this section, we first outline key design decisions for adapting VLAs to novel robot setups and tasks and provide details on their implementation.
translation: 决策 在本节中，我们首先概述将视觉语言动作模型适配到新机器人设置和任务的关键设计决策，并提供其实现细节。

source: A. VLA Fine-Tuning Design Decisions
translation: A. 视觉语言动作微调设计决策

source: Existing approaches that fine-tune VLAs using the base model’s autoregressive training recipe face two key limitations: slow inference speed (3-5 Hz) unsuitable for high-frequency control, and unreliable task execution on bimanual manipulators ⟦0⟧. To address these challenges, we investigate three key design components for VLA fine-tuning:
translation: 现有使用基础模型自回归训练方案微调视觉语言动作模型的方法面临两个关键局限性：推理速度慢（3-5赫兹），不适合高频控制；以及在双臂机械手上任务执行不可靠⟦0⟧。为应对这些挑战，我们研究了视觉语言动作微调的三个关键设计组件：

source: (a) Action generation strategy (Figure 2, left): We compare autoregressive generation, which requires sequential token-by-token processing, with parallel decoding, which generates all actions simultaneously and enables efficient action chunking. (b) Action representation (Figure 2, right): We examine discrete actions (256-bin discretization of normalized actions) processed through softmax-based token prediction, versus continuous actions directly generated by an MLP action head. For discrete actions, the final hidden states of the language model decoder are linearly projected into logits, which are processed by a softmax operation to form the probability distribution over action tokens. For continuous actions, the final hidden states are instead mapped directly to normalized continuous actions by a separate action head MLP. (c) Learning objective (Figure 2, right): We compare policies fine-tuned with next-token prediction for discrete actions, L1 regression for continuous actions ⟦0⟧, and conditional denoising diffusion ⟦1⟧ for continous actions (similar to Chi et al. ⟦2⟧).
translation: （a）动作生成策略（图2，左）：我们比较了自回归生成（需要逐令牌顺序处理）与并行解码（同时生成所有动作并实现高效动作分块）。（b）动作表示（图2，右）：我们考察了离散动作（归一化动作的256箱离散化）通过基于Softmax函数的令牌预测处理，与连续动作由多层感知机动作头直接生成。对于离散动作，语言模型解码器的最终隐藏状态被线性投影为逻辑值，经Softmax函数处理形成动作令牌上的概率分布。对于连续动作，最终隐藏状态则通过单独的动作头多层感知机直接映射为归一化连续动作。（c）学习目标（图2，右）：我们比较了针对离散动作的下一令牌预测微调策略、针对连续动作的L1回归⟦0⟧，以及针对连续动作的条件去噪扩散⟦1⟧（类似于Chi等人⟦2⟧）。

source: We conduct our study using OpenVLA ⟦0⟧ as the base model, adapting it via LoRA fine-tuning ⟦1⟧ due to our relatively small training datasets (500 demonstrations versus 1M demonstrations for pretraining).
translation: 我们使用OpenVLA⟦0⟧作为基础模型进行研究，通过低秩适配微调⟦1⟧进行适配，因为我们的训练数据集相对较小（500个演示，而预训练为100万个演示）。

source: B. Implementing Alternative Design Components
translation: B. 实现替代设计组件

source: The base OpenVLA model originally employs autoregressive generation of discrete action tokens optimized via nexttoken prediction. We implement alternative design decisions for fine-tuning while keeping the original pretraining unchanged. We describe the key implementation aspects below, with further details explained in Appendix B.
translation: 基础开放视觉语言动作模型（OpenVLA）最初采用离散动作标记的自回归生成，并通过下一标记预测进行优化。我们在保持原始预训练不变的情况下，实现了用于微调的替代设计决策。下文描述了关键实现方面，更多细节见附录B。

source: Parallel decoding and action chunking.
translation: 并行解码与动作分块。

source: Unlike autoregressive generation which requires sequential token prediction, parallel decoding enables the model to map input embeddings to the predicted output sequence in a single forward pass. We modify the model to receive empty action embeddings as input and replace the causal attention mask with bidirectional attention, allowing the decoder to predict all actions simultaneously. This reduces action generation from⟦0⟧ sequential passes to a single pass, where⟦1⟧ is the action dimensionality. Parallel decoding naturally extends to action chunking: to predict actions for multiple future timesteps, we simply insert additional empty action embeddings in the decoder’s inputs, which are then mapped to a chunk of future actions. For chunk size⟦2⟧, the model predicts⟦3⟧ actions in one forward pass, increasing throughput⟦4⟧-fold with minimal latency impact. While parallel decoding may theoretically be less expressive than autoregressive approaches, our experiments show no performance degradation across diverse tasks.
translation: 与需要顺序预测标记的自回归生成不同，并行解码使模型能够在单次前向传播中将输入嵌入映射到预测的输出序列。我们修改模型以接收空动作嵌入作为输入，并将因果注意力掩码替换为双向注意力，从而使解码器能够同时预测所有动作。这将动作生成从⟦0⟧次顺序传递减少到单次传递，其中⟦1⟧是动作维度。并行解码自然扩展到动作分块：为了预测多个未来时间步的动作，我们只需在解码器的输入中插入额外的空动作嵌入，然后将其映射到未来动作块。对于块大小⟦2⟧，模型在一次前向传播中预测⟦3⟧个动作，将吞吐量提高⟦4⟧倍，同时对延迟影响最小。虽然并行解码在理论上可能比自回归方法表达能力弱，但我们的实验表明在各种任务中性能没有下降。

source: Continuous action representations.
translation: 连续动作表示。

source: OpenVLA originally uses discrete action tokens where each action dimension is normalized to⟦0⟧ and uniformly discretized into 256 bins. While this approach is convenient since it requires no architectural modifications to the underlying VLM, the discretization process can sacrifice fine-grained action details. We study continuous action representations with two learning objectives drawn from prominent imitation learning approaches: First, similar to Zhao et al. ⟦1⟧, we implement L1 regression by replacing the decoder’s output embedding layer with an MLP action head that directly maps final decoder layer hidden states to continuous action values. The model is trained to minimize the mean L1 difference between predicted and ground-truth actions, maintaining the efficiency benefits of parallel decoding while potentially improving action precision. Second, inspired by Chi et al. ⟦2⟧, we implement conditional denoising diffusion modeling where the model learns to predict noise added to action samples during forward diffusion. During inference, the policy gradually denoises noisy action samples via reverse diffusion to produce real actions. While this approach offers potentially more expressive action modeling, it requires multiple forward passes during inference (50 diffusion steps in our implementation), impacting deployment latency even with parallel decoding.
translation: OpenVLA 最初使用离散动作标记，其中每个动作维度被归一化到⟦0⟧并均匀离散化为 256 个区间。虽然这种方法很方便，因为它不需要对底层视觉语言模型进行架构修改，但离散化过程可能会牺牲细粒度的动作细节。我们研究了连续动作表示，并采用了来自著名模仿学习方法的两个学习目标：首先，与 Zhao 等人⟦1⟧类似，我们通过用多层感知机动作头替换解码器的输出嵌入层来实现 L1 回归，该动作头直接将最终解码器层的隐藏状态映射到连续动作值。模型训练以最小化预测动作与真实动作之间的平均 L1 差异，在保持并行解码效率优势的同时可能提高动作精确率。其次，受 Chi 等人⟦2⟧启发，我们实现了条件去噪扩散建模，其中模型学习预测前向扩散过程中添加到动作样本上的噪声。在推理过程中，策略通过反向扩散逐步对噪声动作样本进行去噪以产生真实动作。虽然这种方法可能提供更具表达力的动作建模，但它在推理过程中需要多次前向传递（在我们的实现中为 50 个扩散步骤），即使采用并行解码也会影响部署延迟。

source: Additional model inputs and outputs.
translation: 额外的模型输入和输出。

source: While the original OpenVLA processes a single camera view, some robot setups include multiple viewpoints and additional robot state information. We implement a flexible input processing pipeline: For camera images, we use OpenVLA’s dual vision encoder to extract 256 patch embeddings per view, which are projected into the language embedding space with a shared projector network. For low-dimensional robot state inputs (e.g., joint angles and gripper state), we employ a separate projection network to map these into the same embedding space as one additional input embedding. All input embeddings—visual features, robot state, and language tokens—are concatenated along the sequence dimension before being passed to the decoder. This unified latent representation enables the model to attend to all available information when generating actions. Combined with parallel decoding and action chunking, this architecture can efficiently process rich multimodal inputs while generating multiple timesteps of actions, as illustrated in Figure 1.
translation: 虽然原始的 OpenVLA 处理单个相机视图，但一些机器人设置包括多个视点和额外的机器人状态信息。我们实现了一个灵活的输入处理流程：对于相机图像，我们使用 OpenVLA 的双视觉编码器为每个视图提取 256 个补丁嵌入，这些嵌入通过共享投影网络投影到语言嵌入空间中。对于低维机器人状态输入（例如关节角度和夹爪状态），我们采用单独的投影网络将它们映射到相同的嵌入空间中，作为一个额外的输入嵌入。所有输入嵌入——视觉特征、机器人状态和语言标记——在传递给解码器之前沿序列维度进行拼接。这种统一的潜在表示使模型在生成动作时能够关注所有可用信息。结合并行解码和动作分块，该架构可以高效处理丰富的多模态输入，同时生成多个时间步的动作，如图 1 所示。

source: Challenges with language following.
translation: 语言遵循方面的挑战。

source: When deploying on the ALOHA robot setup with multiple viewpoints including from wrist-mounted cameras, we observe that policies can struggle with language following due to spurious correlations in visual inputs. During training, policies may learn to latch onto such spurious correlations when predicting actions, rather than properly attending to the language instructions, resulting in poor adherence to the user’s commands at test time. Furthermore, language inputs may only be critical at specific moments in a task—for example, after grasping the spoon and deciding which ingredient to scoop in the “scoop X into bowl” task discussed in Section VI. Therefore, without special techniques, training the model to appropriately focus on language inputs can be particularly challenging.
translation: 在 ALOHA 机器人平台上部署时，由于包含腕部摄像头在内的多个视角，我们观察到策略可能因视觉输入中的虚假相关性而在语言遵循上遇到困难。在训练过程中，策略在预测动作时可能学会依赖这些虚假相关性，而不是恰当地关注语言指令，导致测试时对用户命令的遵循效果不佳。此外，语言输入可能只在任务的特定时刻才至关重要——例如，在第六节讨论的“将 X 舀入碗中”任务中，抓住勺子后决定舀取哪种食材的时刻。因此，如果没有特殊技术，训练模型恰当地关注语言输入会特别具有挑战性。

source: V. EXPERIMENTS: EVALUATING VLA FINE-TUNING
translation: 五、实验：评估视觉语言动作微调

source: DESIGN DECISIONS In this section, we evaluate the effects of our proposed VLA adaptation design decisions through controlled experiments aimed at answering three key questions:
translation: 设计决策 在本节中，我们通过受控实验评估所提出的视觉语言动作适应设计决策的效果，旨在回答三个关键问题：

source: 1) How does each design decision affect the fine-tuned policy’s success rate on downstream tasks?
translation: 1）每个设计决策如何影响微调策略在下游任务上的成功率？

source: 2) How does each design decision affect model inference efficiency (action generation throughput and latency)?
translation: 2）每个设计决策如何影响模型推理效率（动作生成吞吐量和延迟）？

translation: 3）替代微调公式如何影响模型输入输出规范的灵活性？

source: A. LIBERO Experimental Setup
translation: A. LIBERO实验设置

We use four task suites—LIBERO-Spatial, LIBERO-Object, LIBERO- Goal, and LIBERO-Long—each providing 500 expert demonstrations across 10 tasks to assess policy generalization to different spatial layouts, objects, goals, and long-horizon tasks. Following Kim et al. ⟦1⟧, we filter unsuccessful demonstrations and fine-tune OpenVLA via LoRA ⟦2⟧ on each task suite independently. We train for 50-150K gradient steps

We test checkpoints every 50K steps and report the best performance for each run. Unless specified otherwise, policies receive one third-person image and language instruction as input. For methods using action chunking, we set chunk size to⟦0⟧ to match the Diffusion Policy baseline ⟦2⟧, and execute full chunks before replanning, which we find improves both speed and performance. source: B. LIBERO Task Performance Comparisons
translation: B. LIBERO任务性能比较

source: For satisfactory deployment, robot policies must demonstrate reliable task execution. We first assess how different VLA fine-tuning design decisions affect success rates on the LIBERO benchmark. Our efficiency analysis (which we discuss later) reveals that parallel decoding (PD) and action chunking (AC) together are necessary for high-frequency control (25-50+ Hz), especially for bimanual robots with double the amount of action dimensions. We therefore evaluate OpenVLA policies with both techniques used jointly, comparing variants using discrete actions, continuous actions with L1 regression, and continuous actions with diffusion. Results in Table I show that parallel decoding and action chunking not only increase throughput but also improve performance significantly, raising average success rates by 14% (absolute) over autoregressive OpenVLA policies. This improvement is particularly pronounced in LIBERO-Long, suggesting that action chunking helps capture temporal dependencies ⟦0⟧ and reduce compounding errors ⟦1⟧, which ultimately leads to smoother and more reliable task execution. In addition, we find that using continuous action variants further improves success rates by 5% (absolute) over the discrete action variant, likely due to higher precision in the action predictions. L1 regression and diffusion variants achieve comparable performance, indicating that the high-capacity OpenVLA model can effectively model the multi-task action distribution even with simple L1 regression.
translation: 为了令人满意地部署，机器人策略必须展示可靠的任务执行能力。我们首先评估不同的VLA微调设计决策如何影响LIBERO基准上的成功率。我们的效率分析（稍后讨论）表明，并行解码（PD）和动作分块（AC）共同对于高频控制（25-50+ Hz）是必要的，特别是对于具有双倍动作维度的双手机器人。因此，我们评估联合使用这两种技术的OpenVLA策略，比较使用离散动作、使用L1回归的连续动作以及使用扩散的连续动作的变体。表I中的结果表明，并行解码和动作分块不仅提高了吞吐量，还显著提高了性能，将平均成功率比自回归OpenVLA策略提高了14%（绝对值）。这种改进在LIBERO-Long中尤为明显，表明动作分块有助于捕捉时间依赖性⟦0⟧并减少复合误差⟦1⟧，最终导致更平滑、更可靠的任务执行。此外，我们发现使用连续动作变体比离散动作变体进一步将成功率提高了5%（绝对值），这可能是由于动作预测的精度更高。L1回归和扩散变体达到了可比的性能，表明高容量的OpenVLA模型即使使用简单的L1回归也能有效地建模多任务动作分布。

source: D. Model Input-Output Flexibility
translation: D. 模型输入输出灵活性

source: As explained in Section IV-B and validated by our efficiency evaluations in the prior section, parallel decoding enables OpenVLA to generate action chunks with minimal latency increase, thereby enhancing flexibility in model outputs. The significant speedup realized by parallel decoding and action chunking creates headroom for processing additional model inputs as well. We demonstrate this by fine-tuning OpenVLA with additional inputs such as robot proprioceptive state and a robot wrist-mounted camera image, which doubles the number of visual patch embeddings being passed into the language model decoder, from 256 to 512. Despite this substantial increase in input sequence length, the fine-tuned OpenVLA policy maintains high throughput (71.4 Hz) and low latency (0.112 sec), as shown in Table II. Evaluating these policies with additional inputs on the LIBERO benchmark reveals further improvements in average success rate across all task suites (Table I). Notably, our enhanced fine-tuned OpenVLA policies outperform even the best fine-tuned⟦0⟧ policies ⟦1⟧—which benefit from a base model with larger-scale pretraining and a more sophisticated learning objective (flow matching ⟦2⟧)—as well as Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MDT) ⟦3⟧ and Seer ⟦4⟧ policies. Even with a simpler base model pretrained on less data than more recent VLAs, we find that our alternative VLA adaptation design decisions empower fine-tuned OpenVLA policies to establish a new state of the art on the LIBERO benchmark.

source: While our experimental results in the prior section demonstrate OpenVLA-OFT’s effectiveness in simulation, successful deployment in the real world, on robot platforms that differ substantially from those seen during pretraining, is crucial for showing broad applicability. We thus assess the efficacy of our optimized fine-tuning recipe on the ALOHA robot setup ⟦0⟧, a real bimanual manipulation platform operating at a high control frequency. We evaluate on novel dexterous manipulation tasks that have never been encountered before during OpenVLA’s pretraining (which only involves singlearm robot data). Prior works ⟦1⟧ have shown that vanilla LoRA fine-tuning with autoregressive VLAs ⟦2⟧ is impractical for such tasks, as its throughput (3-5 Hz for single-arm robots and even lower for bimanual tasks) falls well below the 25-50 Hz required for real-time deployment. We therefore exclude this baseline from our experiments and compare more effective methods that we discuss shortly. In this section, we use an augmented version of our VLA fine-tuning recipe (OFT+) that additionally includes featurewise linear modulation (FiLM) for enhanced language grounding, as described in Section IV-C. We denote the OpenVLA policy instantiated through this augmented fine-tuning recipe as OpenVLA-OFT+.
translation: 虽然我们在上一节中的实验结果表明 OpenVLA-OFT 在仿真中有效，但在真实世界中成功部署到与预训练期间所见平台显著不同的机器人平台上，对于展示广泛适用性至关重要。因此，我们评估了优化后的微调方法在 ALOHA 机器人设置 ⟦0⟧ 上的有效性，这是一个以高控制频率运行的真实双臂操作平台。我们在 OpenVLA 预训练期间从未遇到过的新颖灵巧操作任务上进行评估（预训练仅涉及单臂机器人数据）。先前工作 ⟦1⟧ 表明，使用自回归 VLA ⟦2⟧ 进行普通 LoRA 微调对于此类任务不切实际，因为其吞吐量（单臂机器人为 3-5 Hz，双臂任务甚至更低）远低于实时部署所需的 25-50 Hz。因此，我们在实验中排除了这一基线，并比较了我们即将讨论的更有效的方法。在本节中，我们使用增强版的 VLA 微调方法（OFT+），该方法额外包含特征线性调制（FiLM）以增强语言基础，如第 IV-C 节所述。我们将通过这种增强微调方法实例化的 OpenVLA 策略表示为 OpenVLA-OFT+。

source: The ALOHA platform comprises two ViperX 300 S arms, three camera viewpoints (one top-down, two wrist-mounted), and robot state inputs (14-dimensional joint angles). It operates at 25 Hz (reduced from the original 50 Hz to enable faster training while still maintaining smooth robotic control), with actions representing target absolute joint angles. This setup differs significantly from OpenVLA’s pretraining, which includes single-arm robot data only, a single camera viewpoint from a third-person camera, no robot state inputs, low-frequency control (3-10 Hz), and relative end-effector pose actions. The distribution shift poses a challenge to the adaptation of this model. source: B. Methods in Comparison
translation: B. 比较方法

source: The ALOHA tasks present a significant adaptation challenge for OpenVLA as the base model, given the substantial differences from its pretraining platforms in terms of control frequency, action space, and input modalities. For this reason, we compare OpenVLA-OFT+ against more recent VLAs—RDT-1B ⟦1⟧ and⟦0⟧]—that were pretrained on bimanual manipulation data and might reasonably be expected to perform better on these downstream tasks. We evaluate these models after fine-tuning them using their authors’ recommended recipes, and these methods serve as important points of comparison. Additionally, to provide comparisons with computationally efficient alternatives, we evaluate two popular imitation learning baselines: ACT ⟦2⟧ and Diffusion Policy ⟦3⟧, trained from scratch on each task.
translation: ALOHA任务对OpenVLA作为基础模型提出了显著的适应挑战，因为其在控制频率、动作空间和输入模态方面与其预训练平台存在显著差异。因此，我们将OpenVLA-OFT+与更新的VLA——RDT-1B ⟦1⟧和⟦0⟧]——进行比较，这些模型在双手操作数据上进行了预训练，可能在这些下游任务上表现更好。我们使用作者推荐的微调方案对这些模型进行评估，这些方法作为重要的比较点。此外，为了与计算高效的替代方案进行比较，我们评估了两种流行的模仿学习基线：ACT ⟦2⟧和扩散策略 ⟦3⟧，它们从零开始在每个任务上训练。

source: We evaluate all methods—ACT, Diffusion Policy, RDT-1B, ⟦0⟧, and OpenVLA-OFT+—on our four ALOHA tasks. source: VII. DISCUSSION
translation: VII. 讨论

source: Our study on VLA fine-tuning design decisions reveals how different components impact inference efficiency, task performance, model input-output flexibility, and language following ability. These insights lead to our Optimized Fine- Tuning (OFT) recipe, which enables effective VLA adaptation to novel robots and tasks through parallel decoding, action chunking, continuous actions, L1 regression, and (optionally) FiLM language conditioning. The success of OFT is particularly noteworthy with OpenVLA: despite having no exposure to bimanual robots or multi-view image inputs during pretraining, OpenVLA fine-tuned with OFT can adapt to such configurations and match or even outperform more recent diffusion-based VLAs (⟦0⟧ and RDT-1B) which have encountered bimanual manipulators and multiple input images during pretraining. This demonstrates that a well-designed fine-tuning recipe can have a significant impact on final performance, and existing VLAs can be successfully adapted to new robotic systems without extensive retraining from scratch. Moreover, our results show that a simple L1 regression-based approach with a high-capacity model such as OpenVLA is quite effective for adapting to novel robots and tasks. This approach offers practical advantages over diffusion-based methods: the simpler algorithm leads to faster training convergence and inference speed while maintaining strong performance, making it particularly suitable for real-world robotics applications.
translation: 我们对视觉语言动作模型微调设计决策的研究揭示了不同组件如何影响推理效率、任务性能、模型输入输出灵活性以及语言遵循能力。这些洞见促成了我们的优化微调方案，该方案通过并行解码、动作分块、连续动作、L1回归以及（可选的）FiLM语言条件化，实现了视觉语言动作模型对新机器人和任务的有效适应。优化微调方案的成功在OpenVLA上尤为显著：尽管在预训练期间未接触过双臂机器人或多视角图像输入，经过优化微调方案微调的OpenVLA能够适应此类配置，并达到甚至超越近期基于扩散的视觉语言动作模型（⟦0⟧和RDT-1B），后者在预训练期间已接触过双臂机械臂和多个输入图像。这表明精心设计的微调方案能够对最终性能产生显著影响，且现有视觉语言动作模型无需从头进行大规模重新训练即可成功适应新的机器人系统。此外，我们的结果表明，基于简单L1回归的方法结合OpenVLA这类高容量模型，在适应新机器人和任务方面相当有效。该方法相较于基于扩散的方法具有实用优势：更简单的算法带来更快的训练收敛和推理速度，同时保持强劲性能，使其特别适合现实世界的机器人应用。

source: VIII. LIMITATIONS
translation: 八、局限性

source: While our Optimized Fine-Tuning (OFT) recipe shows promise for adapting VLAs to novel robots and tasks, several important questions remain.
translation: 尽管我们的优化微调方案在将视觉语言动作模型适应新机器人和任务方面展现出前景，但仍存在若干重要问题。

source: Handling multimodal demonstrations.
translation: 处理多模态演示。

source: Our experiments use focused demonstration datasets with a consistent strategy per task. While L1 regression may help smoothen out noise in training demonstrations by encouraging the policy to learn the median mode in demonstrated actions, it may struggle to accurately model truly multimodal action distributions where multiple valid actions exist for the same input, which may not be ideal in cases where the ability to generate alternative action sequences would be beneficial for task completion. Conversely, diffusion-based approaches may better capture such multimodality but risk overfitting to suboptimal modes in training data (see our website for discussions and video illustrations of these nuances). Understanding OFT’s effectiveness with multimodal demonstrations remains an important direction for future work.
translation: 我们的实验使用了专注的演示数据集，每个任务采用一致的策略。虽然L1回归可能通过鼓励策略学习演示动作中的中位数模式来帮助平滑训练演示中的噪声，但它可能难以准确建模真正的多模态动作分布，即同一输入存在多个有效动作的情况，这在生成替代动作序列的能力对任务完成有益的情况下可能并不理想。相反，基于扩散的方法可能更好地捕捉这种多模态性，但存在过拟合训练数据中次优模式的风险（有关这些细微差别的讨论和视频说明，请参见我们的网站）。理解优化微调方案在多模态演示下的有效性仍是未来工作的重要方向。

source: Pretraining versus fine-tuning.
translation: 预训练与微调。

source: Our study focuses specifically on fine-tuning VLAs for downstream tasks. Whether OFT’s benefits extend effectively to pretraining, or whether more expressive algorithms like diffusion are necessary for large-scale training, requires further investigation.
translation: 本研究特别聚焦于针对下游任务对视觉语言动作模型进行微调。正交微调的优势能否有效延伸至预训练阶段，抑或在大规模训练中是否需要扩散等更具表达力的算法，仍需进一步探究。

source: Inconsistent language grounding.
translation: 语言基础不一致。

source: Our ALOHA experiments reveal that OpenVLA without FiLM exhibits poor language grounding, despite showing no such issues in LIBERO simulation benchmark experiments. The source of this discrepancy—whether from the lack of bimanual data in pretraining or other factors—remains unclear and warrants further study.
translation: 我们的移动操作机器人实验揭示，未采用特征线性调制的开放视觉语言动作模型在语言基础方面表现欠佳，尽管在语言智能体基准仿真实验中并未出现此类问题。这一差异的根源——无论是源于预训练中缺乏双手操作数据还是其他因素——尚不明确，有待进一步研究。

source: Base OpenVLA Architecture.

source: OpenVLA combines a fused vision backbone (with both SigLIP ⟦0⟧ and DINOv2 ⟦1⟧ vision transformers), a Llama-2 7B language model ⟦2⟧, and a 3-layer MLP projector with GELU activation ⟦3⟧ for projecting visual features into the language embedding space. The original model processes a single third-person image and a language instruction (e.g., “put eggplant into pot”). The fused vision encoder extracts 256 patch embeddings from each vision transformer, concatenates them along the hidden dimension, and projects them into the language embedding space. These projected features are concatenated with language embeddings along the sequence dimension before being processed by the Llama-2 decoder to output a 7-dimensional robot action representing delta end-effector pose, represented by a string of discrete action tokens. OpenVLA-OFT architecture modifications. OpenVLA- OFT introduces six key changes:
translation: OpenVLA 结合了融合视觉骨干网络（包含 SigLIP ⟦0⟧ 和 DINOv2 ⟦1⟧ 视觉变换器）、Llama-2 7B 语言模型 ⟦2⟧，以及一个带有 GELU 激活函数 ⟦3⟧ 的三层多层感知机投影器，用于将视觉特征投影到语言嵌入空间。原始模型处理单张第三人称图像和一条语言指令（例如，“将茄子放入锅中”）。融合视觉编码器从每个视觉变换器中提取 256 个图像块嵌入，沿隐藏维度将它们拼接，并投影到语言嵌入空间。这些投影特征沿序列维度与语言嵌入拼接，然后由 Llama-2 解码器处理，输出一个 7 维机器人动作，表示末端执行器位姿增量，由一串离散动作标记表示。OpenVLA-OFT 架构修改。OpenVLA-OFT 引入了六项关键改动：

source: B. Implementation Details

source: 1) Parallel Decoding Implementation: In the original OpenVLA autoregressive training scheme, the model receives ground-truth action tokens shifted right by one position as input (a setup known as teacher forcing). A causal attention mask ensures the model only attends to current and previous tokens. At test time, each predicted token is fed back as input for the next prediction. source: The functions⟦0⟧ and⟦1⟧ that project language embeddings to obtain⟦2⟧ and⟦3⟧ are implemented as simple affine transformations. Separate projectors are learned for each transformer block to allow for blockspecific modulation patterns. This design enables the model to learn different modulation patterns at different levels of visual feature processing. One might initially consider modulating each patch embedding independently, as opposed to each hidden dimension of each embedding as discussed in Section IV-C. However, our spatially-agnostic modulation approach more closely mirrors FiLM’s operation in convolutional networks, where modulation applies globally across spatial dimensions since entire feature maps are scaled and shifted by individual elements of ⟦4⟧ and⟦5⟧. This design choice better maintains the benefits of FiLM and improves the policy’s language grounding substantially. We find that an alternative formulation that modulates each patch embedding independently leads to weaker language grounding.

source: 4) Scaling Up OpenVLA-OFT to a Larger Real-World Dataset (BridgeData V2): In Appendix G1, we observe that a single OpenVLA-OFT policy can effectively fit all four LIBERO task suite datasets combined, confirming that the proposed method scales to larger fine-tuning datasets. In this section, we scale up the fine-tuning data further and assess whether OpenVLA-OFT can also fit a real-world robotic manipulation dataset that is significantly larger and more diverse than both the LIBERO datasets and the ALOHA robot datasets discussed in Section VI. Specifically, we train OpenVLA-OFT (without FiLM) on the BridgeData V2 dataset ⟦2⟧, which contains 50,365 real WidowX robot demonstrations (25⟦0⟧ more than the four LIBERO task suites combined).⟦1⟧ We evaluate OpenVLA-OFT on a subset of BridgeData V2 WidowX robot tasks from the evaluation suite used in the original OpenVLA work ⟦3⟧. This representative subset covers the four types of generalization (visual, motion, physical, semantic) as well as language grounding tasks. We compare the task performance of OpenVLA-OFT with that of the public OpenVLA checkpoint, scoring both methods using the same criteria used in the OpenVLA work. As shown in Table XVI, OpenVLA-OFT surpasses OpenVLA on average across these tasks (69.2% versus 65.8%, respectively)—confirming scalability of the proposed OFT approach to much larger and more diverse real robot datasets. Further, we observe that FiLM is not necessary for satisfactory language following in Bridge tasks, likely because the base model has shown effective language following in Bridge tasks.

translation: 图13：“将X放入锅中”任务评估的初始状态（分布外版本）。与该任务的分布内版本（图12）不同，此版本引入了未见过的绿色和橙色碗作为干扰物，以评估对新颖视觉输入的鲁棒性。食物对象的位置在不同试验中沿垂直方向变化15厘米，沿水平方向变化30厘米，锅保持静止。网格的每一行呈现三个相同的初始状态，因为我们在三个目标对象（“青椒”、“红椒”和“黄玉米”）之间循环，使用相同的初始配置，然后再进入下一组初始配置。

source: TABLE XIV: Additional LIBERO experiments: Single policy for all LIBERO task suites and FiLM ablation study. Here we train a single policy on all four LIBERO task suites combined, without FiLM (“OpenVLA-OFT”) and with FiLM (“OpenVLA-OFT+”). Policy inputs here include a third-person camera image, wrist camera image, robot proprioceptive state, and a language instruction. We observe comparable task performance when training on all task suites together versus training on each of them independently. In addition, we find that FiLM has little effect on task performance in LIBERO, given that the variant without FiLM already exhibits good language following.
translation: 表XIV：额外的LIBERO实验：所有LIBERO任务套件的单一策略及FiLM消融研究。此处我们在所有四个LIBERO任务套件组合上训练单一策略，不使用FiLM（“OpenVLA-OFT”）和使用FiLM（“OpenVLA-OFT+”）。策略输入包括第三人称相机图像、腕部相机图像、机器人本体感受状态和语言指令。我们观察到在所有任务套件上联合训练与分别独立训练相比，任务性能相当。此外，我们发现FiLM对LIBERO中的任务性能影响甚微，因为不含FiLM的变体已经表现出良好的语言遵循能力。

source: TABLE XV: Ablation experiment: Fine-tuning OpenVLA from scratch with the OFT recipe. Policy inputs here include a third-person camera image, a wrist camera image, robot proprioceptive state, and a language instruction. The from-scratch policies generally perform worse than the full OpenVLA- OFT policies, confirming that OpenVLA’s pretrained representation is beneficial for downstream policy performance even when the fine-tuning recipe differs substantially from the pretraining recipe.
translation: 表十五：消融实验：使用OFT方法从头微调OpenVLA。此处的策略输入包括第三人称相机图像、腕部相机图像、机器人本体感受状态和语言指令。从头训练的策略通常表现不如完整的OpenVLA-OFT策略，这证实了即使微调方法与预训练方法存在显著差异，OpenVLA的预训练表征仍有利于下游策略性能。
